about.role: Lead Designer / Brand, campaign & digital design
about.intro:
Lead Designer with design experience since 2019 spanning licensed entertainment IP, premium merchandise, large-scale campaigns and e-commerce.

Leads projects from concept through print-ready production and launch, combining hands-on creative direction with web development and international partner coordination.
about.experience:
Independent / Freelance — Designer & Web Developer | 2019–Present | Project-based since 2019; full-time independent practice since June 2026. Visual identities, logo and album artwork, promotional campaigns and bilingual client websites.
Tokyo Dub Agent — Lead Designer | 2023–2026 | Led visual direction across licensed merchandise, websites, campaigns, retail signage and live events. Directed graphics for IP collaborations including Attack on Titan, Ghost in the Shell and Cowboy Bebop, and led design for every AKIBA EDEN LOT collection during tenure.
Decoded Japan — Lead Designer | 2022–2023 | Led visual design for an NFT-based collectible wine library. Created brand and digital materials for Tapestry, plus web, campaign and motion assets across multiple initiatives.
AnimeX Japan — Graphic Designer | 2019–2021 | Created promotional graphics and interface assets for online gaming platforms, collaborating with developers on cohesive user-facing designs.
